blocks.text: Motorcycle riders warned: TCH is not a racetrack, obey traffic rules or else… CEBU CITY, Philippines — Motorcycle riders, who have turned the Transcentral Highway (TCH) into an informal racetrack and a loitering hub, will now be apprehended, issued temporary operator’s permits, or have their motorcycles impounded. Authorities gave this warning today, Nov. 23, as they announce daily operations against this kind of motorcycle riders in the area. The immediate crackdown follows a direct order from Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro after her office received a surge of complaints from residents and business owners living along the mountain highway. READ: Fire volunteer […]...
